stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.11 — Roux Block-internal Orientation Quotient, Frame-preserving Phase Geometry & Method-specific Null Foundry
supersedes: CR0105R111-NAPKIN-PREEXEC-CLARIFICATION-R2 only where frame face U was hard-coded
reason: Static representation audit before execution showed that a physical whole-cube rotation does not relabel cubie color identities into a universal D/L block. The R1.10 diagnostic searched rotation×frame pairs and deduplicated frame labels; therefore the prospective R1.11 quotient must identify a solve-specific unique block-frame equivalence class rather than force every solve into one color frame.

repaired_block_internal_quotient.frame_space: All 24 ordered adjacent-face Roux frames (bottom, first_side); second_side=opposite(first_side), top=opposite(bottom). Each frame has an exact 3-edge+2-corner first-block mask and disjoint opposite second-block mask.
repaired_block_internal_quotient.candidate_space: At the annotated FB endpoint, evaluate all 24 frozen whole-cube orientation transformations crossed with all 24 ordered frames. A pair (orientation,frame) is admissible iff the transformed endpoint exactly solves that frame's first-block 3E+2C mask in full piece+orientation coordinates.
repaired_block_internal_quotient.quotient_class: Group admissible pairs by ordered frame label. The block-internal frame is identified only if exactly one frame group remains, regardless of how many orientation representatives that group contains.
repaired_block_internal_quotient.representative_rule: Within the unique frame group use the numerically smallest frozen orientation index as a deterministic computational representative, but scientific quantities are admitted only if every admissible representative in that same group yields identical FB/SB/CMLL/LSE consistency flags and phase/channel amplitudes to tolerance 1e-12.
repaired_block_internal_quotient.frame_lock: The unique ordered frame and its quotient class are immutable after FB. Later phases cannot choose another frame or a representative outside the FB-derived class.
repaired_block_internal_quotient.face_generalization: CMLL AUF variants use the identified frame's top face, not hard-coded U. LSE is the six edges outside the two blocks defined by the identified frame.
